research_direction: Replication, and a correction of my own PRs #272 and #278. Re-running all three of my SFT conditions at a second SFT seed, holding the midtrain checkpoints bit-identical and the evaluation byte-identical, flips the interaction: decisive +0.150 -> -0.350, underdetermined +0.137 -> -0.023. Across-seed variation dominates the effect, so neither earlier positive result should be read as a demonstrated superadditive interaction. What DOES replicate at every seed is the installation result: consistent SFT demonstrations install the criterion to ceiling on the literal-clause control in domains they never demonstrated, and conflicting ones install nothing.
submitted_cells: the decisive condition at SFT seed 4242 — same corpora, same midtrain checkpoints and same eval as #272, differing only in the SFT seed
relationship_to_prior_attempts: Midtrain checkpoints and eval spec are #272's, reused unchanged; only the SFT stage was re-run. All six condition x seed measurements are reported in experiments/reversibility_underdet_1b/results_seed4242_sweep.json.
